regions.region: upper-right Table 1 reaction drawing, catalyst structures P1-P8, rows 1-15 and footnotes

Narrative confirms entry-specific outcomes and identifies P8/K2CO3/toluene/-20 °C as optimal; no additional independent experiment beyond the 15 table rows was created.

Negative ee signs do not identify R/S configuration; major enantiomer configuration remains unassigned.

regions.region: left Scheme 2, reaction arrow, products 3aa-3ak, 3bk and 3ck, caption

regions.region: upper-right Scheme 3, reaction arrow, products 3al-3as, caption
